lines.text: About halfway through the feast, Jesus taught in the temple courts, and the Jews were amazed at His learning.
Jesus said Abraham gave them the law, yet not one of them kept it.
Jesus said they circumcise a boy on the Sabbath, yet were angry with Him for making a man well.
No one seized Jesus because His hour had not come, and the Pharisees and chief priests sent officers.
Jesus said they would look for Him but not find Him, and the Jews wondered if He would teach Romans.
